name: Quiet Stranger
desc:
The Quiet Stranger is an NPC that rarely spawns as one of the many Random Encounters at [Erisia](location:erisia). He's a scout from [The Ministry](faction:the_ministry) who sits until someone approaches him. He does not appear in view until you go close to him, as he is hiding himself using Murmur: Tacet. Beware that if you talk to him without the 50 Charisma requirements, he will attack you, locking you out of obtaining Murmur: Tacet.

Via having 50 Charisma, you will obtain Murmur: Tacet without having to fulfill any kill requirements.
